5346.title: Native Dictation input delivery remains unverified
5346.rootCauseOneLine: Root cause undetermined: Linux DOM input controls pass, but native macOS text-service delivery cannot be tested here.
5346.proposedFix: Capture native delivery into the composer and a plain textarea in the same macOS BrowserWindow before designing a fix.
5346.caveats: Verified means the same agent reran the positive controls in a second clean checkout with Turbo cache bypassed; it does not mean the native bug was reproduced. Linux lacks native macOS Dictation. No symptom screenshot was possible. Diagnostic source is inline in the report; raw artifacts remain local.
